notes: True bit-perfect on macOS: exclusive output locks the hardware physical format using the device own available ASBD flags, prefers the NonMixable (0x40) integer variant, and verifies nsrt/sfmt/pft three-layer rate equality on every status poll. Shared mode no longer claims bit-perfect; 48000→44100 is labelled as downsampling; Hog exclusive defaults on.
